title_prefix.description: Case-insensitive prefix the incident title must start with. Combined with title_suffix as an AND pair. At least one of title_prefix, title_suffix or title_exact is required.

title_suffix.description: Case-insensitive suffix the incident title must end with. Combined with title_prefix as an AND pair.

title_exact.description: Case-insensitive full title. OR-ed with the title_prefix/title_suffix pair, so one call can match a templated title family and a fixed title at once.

incident_status.description: Sentinel incident statuses to match: New, Active, Closed (case-insensitive). A bare string is accepted and treated as a one-element array. Omitted means every status except Closed. Cannot contain Closed when activate_incident is true.

created_after.description: Only incidents created at or after this instant. ISO-8601 UTC of the exact form yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. Applied server-side.

created_before.description: Only incidents created strictly before this instant. Same format as created_after. Applied server-side.

activate_incident.description: When true, every matched incident that is neither already Active nor Closed is moved to status Active. Closed incidents are refused per incident and never reopened. Anything other than boolean true or the string 'true' is read as false.

max_results.description: Maximum matched incidents to return and, when activating, to write. 1..16 for a read-only call, 1..8 when activate_incident is true. Defaults to that ceiling. total_matched and limited reveal how many matches were dropped.
